notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list speaks to this tower. The list gives Madison County, 583 ft (177.7 m, matching the record), code 8-23 and removed. The name Britton Lane is likely one of the list author's unofficial names (the author's note on unofficial names), and nothing else we read names this tower. The Britton Lane Battlefield (Madison County, 425 Britton Lane, Denmark) is a different site and is mentioned in the story only as a caution against confusion; no source links the tower to it. No Forest Lookouts Tennessee page, NHLR or FFLOS entry exists in the local caches for this name. The record files FE2287 under NGS; no source read explains that code, so the story does not use it. No corrections proposed: the record's elevation, county and removed status match the list. Searches: two WebSearch queries (both returned only the Civil War battle and the state Division of Forestry NRHP PDF, which has no Britton Lane entry). Reads: tnlandforms list, Madison County facility page.
